scientific_integrity: Exact local spectral instability proven for a defined interior class of finite-population discrete reactive-game gradient-ascent fixed points; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified ordered first-argument payoff gradient and self-play convention
Only interior critical-reciprocity profiles with nonconstant forgiveness
No global basins or nonlinear center dynamics claimed
Related learning literature not fully exhaustive
title: Heterogeneous critical-reciprocity states are spectrally unstable under reactive-game gradient learning
